description: A kanban of your bb threads, focused on what needs you first. Group threads by attention, last activity, project, provider, machine, or parent; drag to act — hand-order a column, change a card's state in the drag, or nest a child; sweep stale lanes, snooze threads, and search titles, projects, and branches. Cards show state, pin, pending-interaction badge, update time, and branch or host; a click opens the thread and a modified click opens it in a new window.
